title: The Cursed Tribe
description: Help the cursed Orcs of Largashbur by aiding wise woman Atub in contacting Malacath, then assist Chief Yamarz in reclaiming the desecrated shrine from giants.

base_facts: I am the wise woman of the Orc stronghold Largashbur.
Our tribe has been cursed and giants attack us openly.
I need a Daedra Heart and Troll Fat to perform a ritual to contact Malacath.

GATHER_INGREDIENTS: The player has brought me the ingredients for the ritual.
MALACATHS_JUDGMENT: Malacath has spoken through the ritual and demands Yamarz reclaim the shrine.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The curse on Largashbur has been lifted by Malacath's intervention.
Gularzob has been named the new chief of our tribe in Yamarz's place.
The outsider who aided us has been named Malacath's Champion.
Our tribe is free to leave the stronghold again without fear of the giants.

base_facts: I am the chief of Largashbur, though Malacath considers me weak.
Giants have desecrated Malacath's shrine and I must reclaim it.

ESCORT_YAMARZ: I am traveling to Fallowstone Cave to deal with the giant.
DEFEAT_GIANT: The giant at the shrine has been defeated.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Malacath judged me a weakling unfit to lead and stripped me of my title as chief.
I fell at Giant's Grove after my cowardice was exposed.
Gularzob has replaced me as chief of Largashbur.

base_facts: I am an Orc of Largashbur.

QUEST_COMPLETE: Malacath has named me the new chief of Largashbur, replacing the weakling Yamarz.
The curse on our tribe has been lifted by Malacath's judgment.
The outsider who aided us has been named Malacath's Champion for restoring the shrine.
Shagrol's Hammer transformed into Volendrung when placed on the shrine.

beats.comment: Player hears about trouble at Largashbur. Note: stage 10 is never set in the final game.
Player helps fight the giant and brings Troll Fat and Daedra Heart to Atub.
Atub performs the ritual and Malacath commands Yamarz to reclaim the shrine.
Player escorts Yamarz to Fallowstone Cave and protects him through the cave.
Player defeats the giant at Giant's Grove. Yamarz may die here.
Player returns Shagrol's Hammer to Largashbur and places it on the shrine.
Quest complete. Malacath names Gularzob the new chief. The hammer transforms into Volendrung.
